tools.name: ManageAppTestDatabase
tools.description: Configure isolated H2 fixtures for this app. Enabled configurations are used automatically by RunAppTests with a fresh database per test. Open/close a disposable preview for manual recording. Never print or save the preview URL, which contains temporary credentials.

project.description: Explicit app project ID, never the toolbox ID.

action.description: get reads configuration; save validates and persists fixtures; open creates a fresh recording preview; close destroys it.

sourceEngineId.description: Original H2 database ID the app already references. No ID edits in app code are needed.

schemaSql.description: Simple CREATE TABLE and CREATE INDEX statements for the test schema.

seedSql.description: Synthetic literal INSERT statements, or empty text. Never copy real rows or credentials.

environmentId.description: Only for close; returned by open for this app/user.

tools.name: RunAppTests
tools.description: Replay explicitly selected recording UUIDs for the app being edited. Set all=true only for an intentional full regression run; omitted selection is an error. Reserved suite __platform_smoke__ provides limited visibility/runtime-error coverage only. Poll GetAppTestRun. An enabled ManageAppTestDatabase configuration automatically uses isolated H2 fixtures; a setup/unsupported-operation error must never be bypassed by disabling the configuration.

project.description: Explicit current app project id. Never use the toolbox id or a different app.

suite.description: Single recording UUID, or __platform_smoke__ for a limited visibility check. Names are not accepted. Mutually exclusive with recordingIds and all=true.

pages.description: Optional additional exact recording-name/startPath filter within the explicit selection. Does not select tests by itself.

repeat.description: Optional 1 to 5. Replays each recording this many times in fresh browsers; it passes only if every replay passes, and differing results are reported FLAKY.

recordingIds.description: Relevant recording UUIDs from ListAppTestRecordings for this app; mutually exclusive with suite and all=true.

all.description: Set true only for an intentional full regression run of this app; mutually exclusive with recordingIds and suite. No selection never means all.

outputSchema.description: runId, explicit target, status and maxFixAttempts

tools.name: GetAppTestRun
tools.description: Read a caller-owned run. RUNNING, COMPLETED, ERROR or NO_TESTS. Check counts/classifications; action-only recordings are SKIPPED/NO_ASSERTIONS. scope PAGE_VISIBILITY_SMOKE verifies page visibility only and provides no saved workflow coverage; always report this limited scope. Inspect AMBIGUOUS_SELECTOR (multiple targets), INVALID_SELECTOR (malformed CSS), WRONG_PAGE (route barrier), CLEANUP_FAILED and availableTestIds; these are not generic environment errors. Report historyWarning separately. Use only the runId returned by RunAppTests; use persisted history after restart/eviction.

outputSchema.description: Caller-owned report with target, status, summary, tests and optional reason/evidence

tools.name: ListAppTestRecordings
tools.description: Discover tests for the app being edited. Returns only id, name and description per recording; no steps, selectors or values. Use GetAppTestRecording to read one relevant definition only when needed. Malformed files are returned separately in invalid with file/code/reason; valid tests remain available. Do not silently exclude invalid definitions from a full coverage claim.

tools.name: GetAppTestRecording
tools.description: Read one complete test definition by UUID for the app being edited. Call only when its steps/expectations are needed; running selected IDs does not require reading their definitions first.

project.description: Explicit current app project id, never toolbox id.

outputSchema.description: Explicit target and one complete recording definition

recording.description: Declarative test object, never a JSON string. Omit id for new tests; use the saved UUID for updates. Paths are relative to portals/. pagePath is the expected route BEFORE a step; framePath contains strings for nested iframes, not row/lane containers. Optional cleanupSteps, per-attempt variables and explicit portal-root route matching are supported.

description.description: Explain the workflow and expected outcome this test verifies.

items.description: Declarative action/assertion. Optional pagePath is the app-relative top-level URL expected before the step; replay waits for it, including query/hash routes.

selector.description: CSS selector required except for NAVIGATE and ASSERT_URL. Prefer a unique data-testid.

path.description: Required for NAVIGATE and ASSERT_URL; app-relative destination/expected route, never url. An explicit empty string means portal root.

pagePath.description: App-relative URL expected BEFORE this action, not its destination; preserve entry filename/query/hash.

framePath.description: Optional CSS selectors for nested iframes; omit or [] for the app document.

value.description: String required for FILL, SELECT or ASSERT_VALUE. SELECT/ASSERT_VALUE use the option/input value, not option labels.

text.description: Required for ASSERT_TEXT; checks element text content, not input/select value.

count.description: Expected match count for ASSERT_COUNT; ASSERT_ABSENT requires zero matches.

state.description: Required for WAIT_FOR; no fixed sleeps.

timeoutMs.description: Optional bounded step timeout, also limited by the remaining run deadline.

targetSelector.description: DRAG destination in the same framePath; selector is the source.

id.description: Omit for a new test. For updates use its saved UUID, also used as its filename; never a test name or app id.

startPath.description: Relative to portals/, including entry filename/query/hash. Empty string means portal root. Example: index.html?env=test#/boards/b1. No leading slash.

routeMatch.description: Default EXACT. PORTAL_ROOT explicitly treats portal directory/index.html and empty/#/#/ fragments as equivalent only at the portal entry. Queries always match exactly.

useVariables.description: Default false. Enable built-in {{runId}}, {{testId}}, {{attemptId}}, {{uniqueId}} placeholders. uniqueId is consistent within an attempt and differs across repeats.

tools.name: DeleteAppTestRecording
tools.description: Delete a recording only when explicitly requested; never remove tests to make a run pass.

fileName.description: Only an explicit filename returned in ListAppTestRecordings.invalid. Deletes malformed tests, never a valid test; mutually exclusive with recordingId.

tools.name: ListAppTestRuns
tools.description: List compact persisted test-run summaries and latest per-test results for the current app. Optionally filter one recording UUID. No definitions or private evidence. History retains 100 finished runs plus active runs.

recordingId.description: Optional single test UUID to filter history.

outputSchema.description: Explicit app target and compact persisted history.

tools.name: GetAppTestRunHistory
tools.description: Read one persisted compact app test run. Optional recordingId returns only that test. No screenshots, selectors or captured page text. Requires app edit access.

recordingId.description: Optional single test UUID within the run.

outputSchema.description: Explicit app target and compact persisted history.
